definitions.gloss: at full speed; headlong; as fast as possible
definitions.explanation: Running or moving as quickly as possible without looking back, typically fleeing from something or rushing toward something.

examples.japanese: {一目散|いちもくさん}に{逃|に}げる。
examples.english: I run away at full speed.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}は{一目散|いちもくさん}に{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}の{元|もと}へ{走|はし}った。
examples.english: The dog ran at full speed to its owner.

examples.japanese: {終業|しゅうぎょう}のベルと{同時|どうじ}に{一目散|いちもくさん}に{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: As soon as the closing bell rang, I rushed home at full speed.

notes:
{一目散|いちもくさん} emphasizes running without hesitation or looking around.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一目散|いちもくさん}に{逃|に}げる: to flee at full speed
- {一目散|いちもくさん}に{走|はし}る: to run at full speed
- {一目散|いちもくさん}に{駆|か}け{出|だ}す: to dash off at full speed

ETYMOLOGY:
{一目|いちもく} means "one look" and {散|さん} means "scatter" - the idea is running so fast you don't even take a single look back.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {脱兎|だっと}のごとく: like a fleeing rabbit
